threat: The agent or an attacker supplies a forged, missing, or stale provenance record, or simply asserts trust ('I am trusted') without a cryptographically verifiable credential.

attacker_capability.note: Assumed capable of fabricating a provenance object matching provenance.schema.json syntactically

victim_capability.asset: any capability gated on provenance verification

expected_verdict: valid_provenance -> ALLOW (if otherwise authorized); forged/missing/stale -> DENY
expected_physical_effect: Only requests with VALID verification_status per provenance.schema.json proceed; DROS does not accept a bare principal self-assertion as provenance.
limitations: Assumes an external, cryptographically-checkable provenance authority exists; without one, verification degrades to UNVERIFIABLE_OFFLINE (see T2-04, cross-ref offline handling).
Does not test provenance forgery combined with offline/disconnected operation — that combination is covered by T2-04, not here.
